easyPrerequisites: There is a black card in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it.
When Xiahou Dun dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Xiahou Dun from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
Resolve all Xiahou Dun abilities.
